coverage.instructions: How well does GrapiX cover this Ross XPression feature, going only by the plan rows given?

criteria.built: Built: the rows that cover it are done or already working, so the feature exists.
criteria.planned: Planned: there is a row for all of it but it has not been built (pending).
criteria.partial: Partial: some of it is built or planned, but a named part of the feature has no row or is not built.
criteria.missing: Missing: no row covers it and it does not exist.

core_for_broadcast.instructions: Is this feature core for a broadcast motion graphics application that uses Ross XPression as its benchmark (leaving AI features aside)?

criteria.true: Yes: a broadcast graphics operator or designer will expect it, and the application is not a credible alternative without it.
criteria.false: No: it is optional, rare, vendor-specific or a convenience.
